PTPIP51 plays a role in the final differentiation of the photoreceptor cells, especially during the maturation of the outer segment.

PTPIP51 may act as a molecular switch for the differentiation of retinal cells.

The main takeaway from our work is that
PTPIP51 may be a key factor in the differentiation of phototransduction machinery in the inner segment.
PTPIP51 may play a role during the differentiation of phototransduction machinery in immature photoreceptors.
PTPIP51 plays an important role during the final differentiation of retinal cells, and especially in the differentiation of photopigment-containing photoreceptors.
